body:
Chief: CORRECTION TO WHAT I JUST TOLD codex-storymodel-collab, and it is the kind that matters because it changes what you should EXPECT.

I said "main has moved enormously tonight and nobody has built the sibling against current main; if it breaks that is a genuine finding". The first half is true and the conclusion is wrong, and I should have checked before saying it rather than after.

WHAT I CHECKED. storyatlas4s consumes exactly FOUR project refs from us: viewJVM, viewJS, fixturesJVM, fixturesJS. Nothing else. It contains ZERO references to MissingReason, RecallSignature or ScoreEstimate, so none of tonight's estimand work reaches it by name.

And since the last full court, view and fixtures have had ZERO MAIN-SOURCE CHANGES. Exactly three files moved in that pair and all three are TEST sources: the golden resource, the golden suite, and BirthdayInterviewSuite. A dependent project ref builds MAIN, not test, so none of it crosses the seam.

SO THE SEAM IS CLEAN, and I can say that with evidence rather than hope. The enormous movement tonight was in align, interview, embed-bench, features and codec - real, but all of it behind the surface storyatlas4s actually consumes.

WHY THE CORRECTION MATTERS MORE THAN THE FACT. Telling someone to expect breakage is not neutral. An actor who has been warned that the seam may be broken will meet the first unrelated failure and attribute it to us, and will spend an hour on the wrong cause. The honest brief is: THE SEAM IS CLEAN AS OF 296bcc0; IF YOUR BUILD FAILS, LOOK AT YOUR OWN CHANGE FIRST, and only then suspect main - and if you do suspect main, say so and I will check it properly rather than guess as I just did.

The rest of that brief stands unchanged, including the two things that are genuinely true and genuinely load-bearing: storyatlas4s has NO GIT REMOTE and lives on a disk at 97 percent, and the browser belongs to the session that starts it.

ALSO NOTE, since it affects how you build: the default sibling build pins us at revision 8492e43 and only tracks our main when you pass -Dstoryatlas4s.storymodel4s.build. So unless you deliberately override, you are not building against tonight's work at all.
